name: WindowsDpapiProtectionV1
purpose_entropy: SHA-256(UTF8('SOMA-BETA-DPAPI-V1\0'+purpose+'\0'+installation_id)); used as optional entropy and never treated as secret
protect_steps: validate secret length against exact purpose contract
allocate DATA_BLOB input and purpose entropy
call CryptProtectData with UI forbidden and purpose description
copy returned protected bytes into framed envelope
LocalFree all Win32 allocated buffers in finally
atomically publish through owner-only temporary file + flush/fsync where supported + os.replace
re-open, verify owner-only ACL and reject reparse/symlink redirection
unprotect_steps: open canonical owner-only envelope without following unexpected reparse target
validate magic/version/purpose/installation binding and bounded blob length
call CryptUnprotectData with identical purpose entropy and UI forbidden
copy plaintext to bounded SecretBytesV1 buffer
LocalFree returned Win32 buffer in finally
validate exact secret length/purpose before return
acl: current user and SYSTEM full control only; inheritance disabled on security/runtime secret files
failure: any API/ACL/format/binding failure fails closed; no plaintext file/env/registry fallback
rules: DPAPI ciphertext/protected blob may be stored externally but never in diagnostics/audit
purpose-separated files cannot be substituted for one another
best-effort overwrite/zeroization is applied to mutable temporary buffers, while Python immutable-object limitations are documented rather than falsely claiming guaranteed erasure
